title: Walk-In FIFO Scramble
briefing: Truck came in. Produce is jammed in front of last week's. Fix it before something rots.

expertRecipe.name: Walk-In FIFO Standard
expertRecipe.platingStandard: Oldest product in front, all items dated, spoiled product pulled.

steps.instruction: Glove up and grab a marker.
steps.whyExplanation: Bare hands in a walk-in = cross-contamination between ready-to-eat and raw.

steps.instruction: Pull any product past use-by date.
steps.whyExplanation: Expired product must be discarded, not pushed to the back. One spoiled item can contaminate the shelf.
Undated product becomes mystery meat. Without a date, FIFO is impossible.

steps.instruction: Rotate existing stock to front of shelf.
steps.whyExplanation: FIFO: First In, First Out. Oldest product gets used first to prevent waste.

steps.instruction: Place new delivery behind existing stock.
steps.whyExplanation: New product behind old ensures the next cook grabs the oldest first.

criticalControlPoints.consequence: Serving expired product is a health code violation and potential lawsuit.
